local data = {
	Employment_Contracts = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Employment_Contracts'),
	Operator_Tokens = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Operator_Tokens'),
	Operator_Snapshots = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Operator_Snapshots'),
	Weapons = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Weapons'),
	Gear = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Gear'),
	Progression_Materials = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Progression_Materials'),
	Rare_Materials = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Rare_Materials'),
	Gatherables = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Gatherables'),
	Naturals = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Naturals'),
	AIC_Products = mw.loadData('Module:Item/AIC Products'),
	Facilities = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Facilities'),
	Quest_Items = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Quest_Items'),
	Gifts = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Gifts'),
	Seeds = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Seeds'),
	Containers = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Containers'),
	Consumables = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Consumables'),
	Packages = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Packages'),
	System_Blueprints = mw.loadData('Module:Item/System_Blueprints'),
	Essences = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Essences'),
	Formulas = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Formulas'),
	Photo = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Photo'),
	Profile = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Profile'),
	Etchspace = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Etchspace'),
	Sanity = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Sanity'),
	Currency = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Currency'),
	Headhunting = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Headhunting'),
	Miscellaneous = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Miscellaneous'),
	Personal_Device = mw.loadData('Module:Item/Personal_Devices'),
}
function p.getItemAttr(itemKey, attr)
	if type(itemKey) ~= "string" then
		error("Invalid item key: Expected string, got " .. type(itemKey))
	end
	local item
	for _, module in pairs(data) do
		item = module[itemKey]
		if item then break end
	end
	if not item then
		error("Item not found: " .. itemKey)
	end
	return item[attr] or ""
end
function p.itemDescription(frame)
	local itemKey = frame.args[1] or frame.args.item
	return p.getItemAttr(itemKey, "desc")
end
function p.itemUse(frame)
	local itemKey = frame.args[1] or frame.args.item
	return p.getItemAttr(itemKey, "use")
end
local getArgs = require('Module:Arguments').getArgs
local yesno = require('Module:Yesno')
-- local function that returns all needed attrs needed for the tooltip of an item
local function getItemAttrs(itemKey)
	if type(itemKey) ~= "string" then
		error("Invalid item key: Expected string, got " .. type(itemKey))
	end
	local item
	for _, module in pairs(data) do
		item = module[itemKey]
		if item then break end
	end
	
	if not item then
		mw.log('Item not found: '..itemKey)
		return '[['..itemKey..']]'
	end
	
	local tier = tonumber(item.tier) or 1
	local description = item.desc or "No description available"
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = item.name,
		['data-title'] = item.title,
		['data-tier'] = tier,
		['data-use'] = item.use,
		['data-desc'] = description,
		['data-obtain'] = item.obtain,
		['data-filename'] = item.image,
		['data-link'] = item.link,
	}
	return attrs
end
-- function used to create the html objects required for an item display box
local function renderItemBox(itemName, count, attrs)
    if not itemName or itemName == "" then
        return ""
    end

    local rarity = attrs['data-tier'] or 1

    local bgClasses = {
        [1] = "item-bg-t1",
        [2] = "item-bg-t2",
        [3] = "item-bg-t3",
        [4] = "item-bg-t4",
        [5] = "item-bg-t5",
        [6] = "item-bg-t6",
    }
    local barClasses = {
        [1] = "item-bar-t1",
        [2] = "item-bar-t2",
        [3] = "item-bar-t3",
        [4] = "item-bar-t4",
        [5] = "item-bar-t5",
        [6] = "item-bar-t6",
    }

	local dim = 55
    local filename = attrs['data-filename'] or itemName
    local link = attrs['data-link'] or itemName

    local countText = ""
    if count and math.abs(count) > 0 then
    	local M = 10^6
		local K = 10^3
		
		if math.abs(count) >= M then
			count = (count / M) .. 'M'
		elseif math.abs(count) >= K then
			count = (count / K) .. 'K'
		end
		
        countText = tostring(count)
    end

    -- wrapper with margin
    local box = mw.html.create("div")
        :addClass("item-box-wrapper")

    -- background / main square
    local bg = box:tag("div")
        :addClass("item-bg")
        :addClass(bgClasses[rarity])

    -- image wrapper
    local inner = bg:tag("div")
    	:addClass("item-inner")

    -- tooltip
    local a = inner:tag("div")
        :addClass("a")

    local tt = a:tag("div")
        :addClass("item-tooltip")
        :attr(attrs)
        :wikitext(('[[File:%s.png|%sx%spx|link=%s]]'):format(filename, dim, dim, link))

    -- rarity color bar thing at the bottom
    tt:tag("div")
        :addClass("item-bar")
        :addClass(barClasses[rarity])

    -- item count
    if countText ~= "" then
        box:tag("div")
            :addClass("item-count")
            :wikitext(countText)
    end

    return tostring(box)
end
-- public function that can be called by other modules to generate an item display
function p.renderItemBox(itemName, count)
	local attrs = getItemAttrs(itemName)
	
	if type(itemName) ~= "string" then
		error("Invalid item key: Expected string, got " .. type(itemName))
	end
	local item
	for _, module in pairs(data) do
		item = module[itemName]
		if item then break end
	end
	
	if not item then
		mw.log('Item not found: '..itemName)
		return '[['..itemName..']]'
	end
	
	local tier = tonumber(item.tier) or 1
	local description = item.desc or "No description available"
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = item.name,
		['data-title'] = item.title,
		['data-tier'] = tier,
		['data-use'] = item.use,
		['data-desc'] = description:gsub('\n', '<br>'),
		['data-obtain'] = item.obtain,
		['data-filename'] = item.image,
		['data-link'] = item.link,
	}
	
	return renderItemBox(itemName, count, attrs)
end
function p.main(frame)
	local args = getArgs(frame)
	return p._main(args)
end
function p._main(args)
	local key = args[1]
	local sign, qty = string.match(args[2] or '', '^([%+%-]?)(%d+)')
	qty = tonumber(qty)

	if not key then error('Item name is required') end
	local item
	for k, v in pairs(data) do
		item = v[key]
		if item then
			break
		end
	end
	if not item then
		mw.log('Item not found: '..key)
		if qty and math.abs(qty) > 0 then
			return '[['..key..']]×'..qty
		else
			return '[['..key..']]'
		end
	end
	local name = item.name
	local filename = item.image or name
	local text = item.title or name
	local link = item.link or name
	local tier = tonumber(item.tier) or 0
	local description = item.desc or "No description available"
	local attrs = {
		['data-name'] = item.name,
		['data-title'] = item.title,
		['data-tier'] = tier,
		['data-use'] = item.use,
		['data-desc'] = description:gsub('\n', '<br>'),
		['data-obtain'] = item.obtain,
		['data-filename'] = item.image,
		['data-link'] = item.link,
	}
	local gdim = tonumber(item.gdim) or 22
	local gridview = yesno(args.g or args.gv or args.gridview)
	if gridview == nil then
		gridview = true
	end
	
	local root = mw.html.create('')
	if gridview then
		return renderItemBox(name, qty, attrs)
	else
		local span = root:tag('span')
		:css('display', 'inline-block')
		if qty and math.abs(qty) > 0 then
			span:wikitext(sign..qty..' ')
		end
		local tt = span:tag('span')
		:addClass('item-tooltip')
		:attr(attrs)
		:wikitext(('[[File:%s.png|%sx%spx|link=%s|alt=%s]] [[%s|%s]]'):format(filename, gdim, gdim, link, text, link, text))
	end
	return root
end
return p
